findings.text: the fitted target and the asserted coefficients both come from the (p_prime, ff_prime) pair the test itself hands to toroidal_current_density, so the assertion holds under any value or sense of TOTAL_FLUX_FACTOR and cannot show the consumer's sign is COCOS 17; it reddens only if Surface.fit's divisor diverges from the owner's factor

the recorded negative control returns nova/io/signalstore.py::cache_key to its pre-convention identity, a consumer this node measured but did not convert, so no log shows nova/biot/contour.py:55 reddening on its own revert; the plan's literal control asks for a converted consumer

the recorded arms measure only files importing nova.biot.contour and none of the certified forward-solve rows or analytic oracles the section's done_when names, so the unchanged-magnitude claim rests on the algebra (-2*pi equals -TOTAL_FLUX_FACTOR) rather than on a measured row delta
